page.overview:
Who is Cloud?

Cloud is a minor character in World of Final Fantasy. He is a Grymoirian incarnation of Cloud Strife originating from Final Fantasy VII. Cloud is one of the five character representatives of the Final Fantasy VII series, the other four being Tifa, Sephiroth, Shelke, and Zack (the latter appearing only in the Maxima version).

The player can take on Intervention Quests that center around Cloud.

Cloud also appears in the following Intervention Quest.

As a Champion, Cloud can be summoned to assist Lann and Reynn in battle. Upon acquiring Cloud's Champion Medal, the player can summon him to attack one enemy with the ability Omnislash. The party is also bestowed with .
